reply_text:
I replied to Kwame in the #coastal-team thread. I can't see any CRM record for Pellucid Harbor Logistics, so I can't confirm what the CRM says. The shared files only list Moss's digests and member notes, with no account CRM files.

The written record puts the official handoff at **November 3, 2025**. Moss's Coastal digest from Nov 2 and Bettina's Dec 8 cutover recap both give that date. The recap also says Bettina kept running the account day to day until Nov 21, and that Kwame fully took over on Nov 22. I suggested he check which of those two dates the CRM was entered against.
